body.statement: For every compatible \(p_x\), \(v_x^{\Box}(p_x)=v_x(p_x)\) if and only if \(\mathcal F_x^{\mathrm{val}}(p_x)\neq\varnothing\). Equality of the complete optimizer correspondences, \(Q_x^{\Box}(p_x)=Q_x^*(p_x)\), holds if and only if \(\mathcal F_x^{\mathrm{arg}}(p_x)\) holds. Both conditions admit finite observable basis certificates.
body.justification: Value preservation and rule preservation are distinct questions, and the theorem locates their exact observable frontiers.
body.gap: HruzaEtAl2026CategoricalPIL uses coordinatewise bounds in its loss, while SongEtAl2026CategoricalIV supplies joint restrictions; no prior theorem states when discarding those restrictions is decision-neutral.
body.consumer: The certificate tells a user of interval-based categorical policy learning whether the existing objective is safe or must be replaced by the joint oracle.
